incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT auto-pager: elevated 5xx rate observed in prod-us-west (gateway + model-runner). Pager triggered for oncall. System tags: runtime, kvcache, segfaults, OOMs. Link: https://infra.redwood/incidents/1799998887
Alex K: got the pager, I'm on it. starting quick triage.
Sam R: I see spike on gateway -> 502s from model-runner pool, roughly 12 nodes showing repeated restarts.
Maria P: kvcache growth looks suspicious — observing sustained increase in `kvcache.size` on pod infer-node-22..25, eviction latency > 200ms.
Jen L: logs from infer-node-24 show `segfault at 0x0` in attention kernel then immediate restart. attaching snippet.
Jen L: ```
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z infer-node-24 kernel: segfault in libattention.so: 0x7f...
E inference: runtime::alloc failed: OutOfMemoryError: requested 1.2GB but only 800MB available
Stack: model_runner::kv_cache::insert -> model_runner::attention::forward -> main
```
Alex K: ok — two failure modes: kernel segfaults on attention path + OOM while kvcache fills. short-term: route traffic off these nodes and enable fallback model variant.
Sam R: rolling route fallback for `/v1/generate` to `gpt-small-quant` in us-west to reduce memory pressure. command: `redwood route set-variant --route /v1/generate --variant gpt-small-quant --region us-west --reason "live 5xx mitigation"`
Maria P: also triggering kvcache purge on the pool: `redwood runtime kvcache purge --pool model-runner-uswest --confirm`. this should free KV entries and reduce mem.
Jen L: restarting pods infer-node-23..25 one-by-one after purge. `kubectl delete pod infer-node-24 -n inference --grace-period=30` then watch logs.
Sam R: initial effect: gateway 5xx down from 14% -> 6% within 90s after route fallback + purge. latency still elevated ~1200ms p95.
CS Bot: Notifying affected customers (A/Prod, B/Realtime) via status page: "Degraded performance in us-west region; fallback routing in progress."
Alex K: good. I'm enabling autoscale bump for the dedicated pool to handle backlog: `redwood compute scale --pool model-runner-uswest --min 2 --max 6 --force`. that buys headroom.
Maria P: monitoring KVS eviction metrics now — eviction latency back to ~30ms, memory usage per node trending down.
Jen L: one node (infer-node-24) still showing segfaults after restart — quarantined and removed from LB. adding to postmortem list.
Sam R: can we fail open routing to multi-region (us-east) for high-SLA customers?
Alex K: yes — enabling cross-region failover for customer A only for now. `redwood routing set-failover --customer A --from us-west --to us-east`
Sam R: failover complete for A, observing reduced errors for their traffic.
CS Bot: Customer A acknowledged, appreciates the proactive failover.
Alex K: summary so far: cause likely kvcache growth combined with attention-kernel instability causing OOM->segfaults. short-term mitigations: route fallback to smaller model, kvcache purge, restart/quarantine bad nodes, autoscale bump, cross-region failover for high-SLA customers.
Maria P: capturing metric snapshots for post-incident analysis and setting alert thresholds: `kvcache.size > 85%` and `kernel-segfault > 1/min` to trigger earlier.
Jen L: created ticket INF-4579 to track kernel regression and add stricter memory accounting in runtime.
Alex K: handing off to Sam R for next 30m — Sam, I'm reachable if you need help. leave runbook entries: steps executed, pods quarantined: infer-node-24, infer-node-25, route rollback commands, purge command.
Sam R: acknowledged, I'll run next checks and keep CS notified. I'll escalate to eng-ml if segfaults reappear after purge.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress, error rate reduced but monitoring continues. Next update in 15m or on state change. :white_check_mark:
